New Functions: [JIRA-68470] KDS2.0 - Support to view ticket when disconnect with internet
Descriptions:
Changed the KDS client frontend to build as a Progressive Web App (PWA). Browser will cache the page data in local storage and allow opening the page without internet access.
As the site is cached, to use the latest version of the KDS client, user needs to do a full page reload. The KDS client will automatically check if a new version is published during the initial set up stage after login. If an upgrade is available, users will be able to see a notification when entering the tickets page.
For data loading from backend without internet access (e.g. display list, device info), we will use the data stored in IndexedDB if the HTTP API call failed.
Setup:
When opening the KDS client, a service worker is automatically registered, managing the cache for the site’s page data.
Sign in is an online action, the KDS Client must acquire the access token from KDS backend to be able to sign in. When offline, users cannot sign in. Offline mode support only works when network is available.
* For page reload of a signed in client in offline mode, the KDS client will automatically skip the sign in page.
Users can normally view tickets, switch pages, select/unselect processing statuses, change display when offline.
At this stage, a page refresh will load the same data and show back this page normally even if offline.

The cloud and signal icon will turn red when disconnected to the KDS backend and MQTT respectively.
When there is a new published version of the KDS Client, and the user does not do any refresh on the page, a notification box will pop up in the bottom right. Clicking the upgrade button will trigger a page reload.
The upgrade button will also exist in settings -> System Information menu in tickets page.
After the internet access is restored. The KDS Client will try to call API from backend to load the latest tickets.

requirement.summary: SJM - Gaming System - Wording Issue for Triggering the Scan Barcode Function
requirement.description:
Vender Key: sjm

Related enhancement cases: JIRA-63889, JIRA-64200, JIRA-64742 and JIRA-67883 implemented the trigger of the scan barcode function.

The function itself is working correctly. However, when the system prompts the user to scan a barcode, the popup message currently displays:

"Scan barcode / Swipe card"

"Please scan barcode / swipe card"

This wording is incorrect and causes confusion. At present the system only supports barcode scanning and does not support card swipe(MSR). Displaying the “swipe card” option misleads users.

Requested change:

Update the popup message text from

"Scan barcode / Swipe card"

"Please scan barcode / swipe card"

to

"Scan barcode"

"Please scan barcode"

This wording correction will eliminate user confusion and align the prompt with the actual supported functionality.

requirement.summary: Handling the deprecated features for RabbitMQ 4.3.X about creating queue
requirement.description:
With planing to upgrade to RabbitMQ 4.3.X, feature 'transient_nonexcl_queues' (durable = false and exclusive = false) is deprecated and it is not permitted by default anymore.

This deprecated features causing system gets "Fail to create queue" error because system uses transient_nonexcl_queues as default queue creation.

It is required to set durable as true and apply reasonable x-expires argument if necessary for all transient_nonexcl_queues usage in POS module related as below

- Shell of publish notification: Create queue with durable as true since it is long-holding queue

- Shell of central push notification: Create queue with durable as true since it is long-holding queue

- Shell of IPTV interface: With MQ host exist, create response queue with durable as true and keeping auto delete as true (auto delete is true currently)

- Shell of portal station load test: Create response queue with durable as true and keeping auto delete as true (auto delete is true currently)

- API portal: Create response queue with durable as true and keeping auto delete as true (auto delete is true currently)

- Shell of download sales data: Create queue with durable as true since it is long-holding queue
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-67901] Handling the deprecated features for RabbitMQ 4.3.X about creating queue (Eli)
Descriptions:
RabbitMQ 4.3.X will deny feature transient_nonexcl_queues by default
It is required to change transient_nonexcl_queues usage in POS module from durable false to true for below workflow
Publish notification
Central push notification
IPTV interface
Portal station load test
Portal station
Download sales data from master for smart station
Expected result:
System work normally without “Fail to create queue” error after upgrading RabbitMQ to 4.3.X version
It is fixed in current version

requirement.summary: POS Interface - HTNG (HotelIFC/Shiji Box) - Block check modifications after partial payment
requirement.description:
User Story

As a POS operator, I want the system to block all modifications to a check after the first partial payment is settled so that posting calculations to the guest folio remain accurate and incorrect charges are prevented.

Current Behavior

When using the HTNG (HotelIFC/Shiji Box) PMS posting interface, a check can be modified after a partial payment has been settled. This can cause calculation discrepancies between the POS check total and the amount posted to the guest folio, resulting in incorrect posting amounts. This issue was observed in support case #1777313 from the EU regional team.

Expected Behavior

All modifications to a check must be blocked after the first completed payment transaction (including partial tenders, deposits, and pre-authorizations) has been settled. A warning message must be displayed explaining that modifications are not allowed after partial payment, and the action must be prevented. This restriction applies to all user roles with no override or bypass capability.

Acceptance Criteria

Block all check modifications after first partial payment

- Given the check has at least one completed payment transaction (partial tender, deposit, or pre-authorization) settled against it

- When a user attempts any modification to the check, including but not limited to: adding an item, deleting an item, changing item quantity, applying an item discount, applying a check discount, voiding a discount, changing the cover count, adding an extra charge, voiding an extra charge, changing the price level, overriding an item price, adding a modifier, changing a modifier, splitting the check, merging the check, transferring the check to another table, changing the meal period, or assigning a member

- Then the system displays a warning message: 'Modifications are not allowed after partial payment'

- And the modification action is blocked and no change is applied to the check

- But if the user attempts to add a further payment or complete the remaining balance, the payment action is allowed and proceeds normally

Restriction applies to all user roles with no override

- Given the check has at least one completed payment transaction settled against it

- When a user of any role — including cashier, server, supervisor, and manager — attempts to modify the check

- Then the modification is blocked with the same warning message

- And no override prompt, manager authorization flow, or bypass mechanism is presented or available

Partial payment trigger definition — all completed payment types activate the restriction

- Given the check has no completed payment transactions

- When any of the following payment transactions is completed and settled on the check: a partial tender for any amount, a deposit (via Add Deposit function key), a pre-authorization (via Payment Interface Card Authorization), or a full tender that leaves a remaining balance on a multi-tender check

- Then the check modification restriction is activated immediately upon settlement of that transaction

- And the check enters a locked state for all modification operations

- But if the payment transaction is voided (via Void Payment) before any additional payments are made, the restriction is lifted and modifications are allowed again

Restriction does not apply to checks with no payment or fully paid checks

- Given the check has zero completed payment transactions (no payment has been applied yet)

- Then all modifications to the check are allowed as normal

- And no warning message is displayed

- But if the check has been fully paid and closed (balance reaches zero), the check is already in a closed state and standard closed-check modification rules apply independently

Supporting Evidence

Support case #1777313 from EU regional team reported incorrect posting amounts when using partial payment with HTNG posting in production.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Enhancement Details

If the check is modified after a partial payment has been settled, it may affect the posting calculation and result in incorrect posting amounts.

To prevent calculation discrepancies, modification of the check should not be allowed after the first partial payment is settled.

Updated on 10 Aug 2026

Update for TBC

- Agree to follow the handling process for unpaid checks after generating a negative check.

- Agree to add a new setup option to enable this feature, which can be configured in the HTNG interface settings.

Original Request / Use Case / Background

We received a support case #1777313 from EU regional team, mentioned about seem when using partial payment with HTNG posting, some related amount is incorrect

Therefore, based on this, we need to think out a solution to fix the related issues

2. Click function "Paid" to go to cashier

requirement.summary: POS Interface - Support for Multiple Advance Orders applied in the same POS check
requirement.description:
Background:-

The current system restriction allowing only one deposit (i.e. Advance Order) to be applied to a single check must be removed.

The system needs to support applying or writing off multiple deposit records on the same check.

Example:

A single check may correspond to multiple deposit entries, and users must be able to write them off individually.

→ This is a common scenario in both operations and financial auditing. If not addressed, it results in incomplete reporting and additional manual reconciliation work.

Please treat this as a high-priority enhancement and include it in the development plan.

As-is:-

Currently only one deposit (i.e. Advance Order) to be applied to a single check in operation

To-be:-

The system needs to allow for multiple deposits (i.e. Advance Order) to be applied to a single check
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-62063/Epic-47408] POS Interface - Support for Multiple Advance Orders applied in the same POS check (Iris Lui)
Descriptions:
It is available for FAS advance order interface
System supports to retrieve multiple advance order returned form external party by function “Retrieve Advance Order” or “Search Advance Order” to same check
System supports multiple values for below printing variables for guest check and receipt with maximum count as 10:
Check Advance Order Interface Balance Amount
Check Advance Order Interface Fax Number
Check Advance Order Interface Customer Name
Check Advance Order Interface Customer Phone
Check Advance Order Interface Deposit Amount
Check Advance Order Interface Deposit Number
Check Advance Order Interface Pickup Date
Check Advance Order Interface Note1
Check Advance Order Interface Note2
Check Advance Order Interface Used Amount
Workflow for retrieve or search advance order
1. Open a check
2. Click function “Retrieve Advance Order” or “Search Advance Order”
3. Follow existing workflow to search and retrieve target advance order
4. If any advanced order is retrieved and attached to the check before, system continues retrieving the new advance order and attaching it to the check without any confirmation and process of clearing previously attached advance orders
5. If no advance order is retrieved and attached to the check before, system follows existing workflow to retrieve the new advance order and attach it to the check
6. Repeat step 2 to 5 if necessary
7. Click function “Print and Paid”
8. Follow existing workflow to settle the check with default payment method specified in interface setup
9. System triggers external API call “writeOffDeposit” with information of all advance orders retrieved on the check
10. Follow existing handling to save the check

Click “Add New” to add record OR select existing check or receipt format
Select the tab “Print Format”

| Printing Variable | Loop belonged to | Available Slip | Description |

requirement.summary: Report - New - Menu Item Sale Report (with Employee Details)
requirement.description:
User Story

As a restaurant manager, I want a new custom Menu Item Sale Report derived from POS153 that adds Employee Name and Reference columns, defaults Show Cost and Show Table Number to selected, and provides a Revenue/Non-Revenue filter, so that I can analyze menu item sales with employee and payment detail for Narendra Bhawan Bikaner.

Current Behavior

The existing Menu Item Sale Report (POS153) does not include Employee Name or Reference columns. The "Show Cost" and "Show Table No" parameters are unticked by default and must be manually selected each time. There is no Revenue/Non-Revenue parameter, so the report cannot filter transactions by revenue classification.

Expected Behavior

A new custom report, "Menu Item Sale Report (with Employee Details)", is created as a separate report entry based on POS153. It retains the existing POS153 structure, columns, and reporting logic, with the following enhancements:

- Adds an "Employee Name" column showing the employee/user who closed the bill for every transaction, regardless of payment type.

- Adds a "Reference" column showing the pay reference manually entered by the operator at bill closure, populated for all payment types.

- "Show Cost" and "Show Table Number" parameters are selected by default.

- Adds a "Revenue/Non-Revenue" parameter with options All / Revenue / Non-Revenue / Revenue+Non-Revenue / Advance Order, defaulting to All. When a specific option is selected, only the matching transactions are shown.

- The new columns appear in both the on-screen report and any exported file formats.

- The existing POS153 report remains unchanged.

Acceptance Criteria

New custom report created

- Given the report list is opened

- When the new custom report 'Menu Item Sale Report (with Employee Details)' is accessed

- Then a separate report entry exists based on POS153 with its structure, columns, and reporting logic retained

- And the existing POS153 Menu Item Sale Report remains unchanged

Employee Name and Reference columns

- Given the new custom report is run

- When the report output is generated

- Then an 'Employee Name' column displays the employee/user who closed the bill for every transaction regardless of payment type

- And a 'Reference' column displays the pay reference manually entered by the operator at bill closure for all payment types

- And both new columns appear in the on-screen report and any exported file formats

- But if no employee was selected at bill closure, the Employee Name column is blank rather than showing an error or incorrect value

- But if no reference was manually entered at bill closure, the Reference column is blank rather than showing an error or incorrect value

Default parameter selection

- Given the new custom report is opened

- When the report parameters are displayed

- Then 'Show Cost' is selected by default

- And 'Show Table Number' is selected by default

Revenue/Non-Revenue parameter

- Given the new custom report is opened

- When the Revenue/Non-Revenue parameter is viewed

- Then the parameter offers options All / Revenue / Non-Revenue / Revenue+Non-Revenue / Advance Order

- And the default selection is All

Revenue/Non-Revenue filtering

- Given the Revenue/Non-Revenue parameter is set to a specific option other than All

- When the report is run

- Then only matching transactions are included in the report output

- And Revenue transactions are identified where Non Revenue Payment = NO

- And Non-Revenue transactions are identified where Non Revenue Payment = YES

- But if the parameter is set to All, both Revenue and Non-Revenue transactions are included

- But if a transaction's payment method has no Non Revenue Payment configuration, it is excluded from Revenue and Non-Revenue filtered results

Supporting Evidence

POS153 – Menu Item Sale Report (base report)

POS114 – Detail Check Report (with Items) – provides field mapping reference for Payment Employee Name and Pay Reference columns

Requested Timeline

Aligned with Priority: Medium

Preferred Quarter: Q4

Notes: Custom report requested for Narendra Bhawan Bikaner (AP region). No hard deadline specified.

Alternatives Considered

Enhancing the existing POS153 report directly was considered, but rejected in favor of keeping POS153 as-is and adding a completely new separate report entry.

Original Description (preserved by INF Prod. Studio)

Enhancement Details

- CUS Report: Menu Item Sale Report (with Employee Details)

- based on POS153

- Add column 'Employee Name': Employee/User who close the bill (refer to POS114)

- Add column 'Reference': Pay Reference (refer to POS114)

- Parameters 'Show Cost' & 'Show Table Number' default tick

- Add new parameter 'Revenue/Non Revenue', default 'All'

_______________________________________________________________________________________________

Summary

Create a new Custom Report for Narendra Bhawan Bikaner, derived from the existing Menu Item Sale Report (POS153).

The report should retain the existing POS153 structure, columns, and reporting logic, with the following enhancements:

CUS Report Name : Menu Item Sale Report (with Employee Details)

1. New Columns

Add the following two columns to the report:

| Column
| Requirement

| Employee Name
| Display the employee/user selected while closing the bill when the Payment Type = Duty Meal.

| Reference
| Display the reference manually entered by the operator while closing the bill.

These two fields are already available in POS114 – Detail Check Report (with Items) Column (Payment Employee Name, Pay Reference) and can be used as a reference for the required data and field mapping.

2. Report Parameters – Default Selection

In the existing POS153 report "Show Cost" and "Show Table No" field exist but remain untick until user manually select it.

In the new custom report parameters, the following options should be selected by default:

- Show Cost

- Show Table Number

3. Revenue / Non-Revenue Parameter

Existing POS153 parameter does not have selection of Revenue / Non-Revenue.

In new custom report add a parameter to allow the user to select between Revenue and Non-Revenue transactions. The report should segregate transactions based on the Non Revenue Payment configuration under the payment method:

- Revenue: Non Revenue Payment = NO

- Non-Revenue: Non Revenue Payment = YES

The selected parameter should determine which transactions are included in the report output.

Sample Screenshot

6. Acceptance Criteria

- New custom report is created based on POS153.

- Employee Name and Reference columns are added and populated with the correct transaction-level data.

- Employee Name is displayed based on the employee/user selected during bill closure for Duty Meal payments.

- Reference displays the value manually entered by the operator during bill closure.

- Show Cost and Show Table Number are selected by default in report parameters.

- Revenue/Non-Revenue selection is available as a report parameter.

- Revenue transactions are identified where Non Revenue Payment = NO.

- Non-Revenue transactions are identified where Non Revenue Payment = YES.

- Existing POS153 report logic and columns remain unchanged apart from the requested enhancements.

requirement.summary: HKJC - TMS - Support setting up Reservation Listing Columns by User in frontend - Dev - 2/2
requirement.description:
20260729 Update: Comments on HERO-64805 Study Result (20260805 further updated)

- UI design Method B

- Merge "Current" & "Calendar"

- Sequence of tabs follow as-is sequence at TBL frontend, i.e. Pending, Waitlist, Host Arrived, Guest Arrived, No Show, Cancelled, All

- Add Copy function: allow copy the column arrangement to other tabs, e.g. from Pending to Host Arrived + Guest Arrived + No Show

- Suggest to add "Copy" function button and let user select copy to which tab(s) (only to those allow to copy to)

- (20260805 supplement) The seven tabs can be divided into 3 sets, each set having the same columns, expect allow to copy between tabs within each set.

- Set 1: Pending, Host Arrived, Guest Arrived, No Show

- Set 2: Waitlist

- Set 3: Cancelled, All

- (20260805 updated) Default select ALL the tabs allow to copy to (within the set)

- (20260805 updated) Copy function also support to copy between Search View and Member View

- "Hide" and "Unhide" function instead of remove and add columns: Use "Hide"/"Unhide" button to set the columns that don't want to display. In the Edit Column dialog, if click "Hide" to a column, turn it to grey and show "Unhide" button. After save, the hidden columns will put to the bottom of the list.

- (20260805 supplement) Mandatory column is not necessary. But to avoid hiding all columns, add checking and IF all columns are hidden, prompt alert when save, "Please select to show at least 1 column."

20260518 Updated:

Question:

1, It is save the setting under browser can meet the requirement? can you give some use case for it? **

2, Is it only by user or user group can meet the requirement?

20260504 Update:

This study case focus on Option 1, save columns setup by user account.

- Current View / Calendar View: need to save different sets for different pages (Pending, Waitlist, Host Arrived, etc...)

- Search View: one set of columns

- Member View: one set of columns

- Save by user account. Can show in backend or not. Expect not editable in backend though.

- List all column headers for drag and drop rearrangement (No need to +/-)

- Set hide/show columns OR  Idea: Function key to put unwanted columns at the last

- Have a default list of columns headers

- Suggest solution if adding new columns in the future

For HKJC HK,

Background

Currently the columns in reservation listing in Current/Calendar/Search/Member Views are with global default. Different outlets/users, however, will have different preferences for columns and sorting.

Requirement

To add a configuration to set up which columns to show in reservation listing, and sorting.

Option 1: By User

- Suggestion: in the front or end of the reservation list, add a "Save Columns Set" button

- User can drag and drop to rearrange columns (as-is)

- When User clicks "Save Columns Set" button, system save the current columns and sorting into user profile

- By Views and page (Current View - Pending page has different set from Current View - Waitlist page)

Option 2: By Outlet Type

- Backend TMS --> Config by Location --> add config to set up Reservation Listing's columns and sorting (reference from TMS 2.0 "Reservation List's Headers on Current/Calendar View")

- Support config by Outlet Type (7 Day Outlet VS Race Day Outlet)

- "Reservation List's Headers on Current/Calendar View (for HKJC)"

- "Reservation List's Headers on Search View (for HKJC)"

- "Reservation List's Headers on Member View (for HKJC)"

- Need to consider "Pending", "Waitlist", "Host Arrived", etc. differences.
